from rich.console import Console
import io

def test_soft_wrap_background():
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=10, soft_wrap=True)
    console.print("This is a long text with a background style", style="on blue")
    val = console.file.getvalue()
    print(repr(val))
    # Also print as escaped to see escape codes
    print(val.encode('utf-8'))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_soft_wrap_background()

import io
from rich.console import Console

def test_soft_wrap_background_newline():
    console = Console(width=20, file=io.StringIO(), force_terminal=True)
    # String with newline in middle
    text = "[on red]Hello\nWorld[/on red]"
    print("--- soft_wrap=True ---")
    console.file.truncate(0)
    console.file.seek(0)
    console.print(text, soft_wrap=True, highlight=False)
    print(repr(console.file.getvalue()))
    
    print("\n--- soft_wrap=False ---")
    console.file.truncate(0)
    console.file.seek(0)
    console.print(text, soft_wrap=False, highlight=False)
    print(repr(console.file.getvalue()))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_soft_wrap_background_newline()

if __name__ == "__main__":
